candidate_title: Step-Audio: Unified Understanding and Generation in Intelligent Speech Interaction

review_output.decision_rationale: The paper performs preference-based audio learning: it constructs chosen/rejected response pairs from user audio, trains a reward model, then applies RLHF/PPO to optimize Step-Audio-Chat. It is clearly an audio speech interaction system (AQTA) and not a survey/review.

candidate_title: A differentiable perceptual audio metric learned from just noticeable differences

review_output.decision_rationale: The paper learns from pairwise audio judgments (“same or different”), trains a neural model from these comparison labels, and then uses the learned metric as a loss to improve speech denoising. It is clearly audio-focused and presents original learning/training experiments, not a survey.
